facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon.
facts.excerpt: in the heart of bustling Tsim Sha Tsui

facts.text: Palm Court is styled after its namesake at The Langham, London, where British Afternoon Tea was first served in 1865.
facts.excerpt: Palm Court is styled after its namesake at The Langham, London — where British Afternoon Tea was first served in 1865.

facts.text: T'ang Court has been recognised by the Michelin Guide since 2009 and holds three Michelin stars.
facts.excerpt: T'ang Court has been recognised by the coveted Michelin Guide since 2009 consistently.

facts.text: The hotel has an art collection by Chinese artists, placed in public areas from the lobby to the restaurants and bar.
facts.excerpt: With artworks created by some of the most renowned Chinese artists, this impressive assembly of artistry is thoughtfully integrated into the hotel's public areas, from the lobby to the restaurants and bar.

facts.text: The Director Suite has a living room with a library of films on a 46-inch smart TV.
facts.excerpt: immerse yourself in our extensive library of films on a 46-inch, high-definition smart TV

facts.text: Guests in Executive Rooms and Suites have complimentary access to The Langham Club.
facts.excerpt: Guests of Executive Rooms and Suites enjoy complimentary access to The Langham Club

facts.text: The Harmony Suite has a separate living room and two bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Harmony Suite offers a separate living room with 2 bathrooms

facts.text: The Chuan Body + Soul spa is on the 15th floor.
The health club has a rooftop heated pool and Jacuzzi.
The spa and fitness studio are only available to guests aged 16 and older.
facts.excerpt: The spa and fitness studio are only available for guests 16 years and older.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the lobby as having marble floors, beige marble walls and a towering chandelier.
facts.excerpt: the elegant lobby has marble floors, beige marble walls, and a towering chandelier.

facts.text: Each room has an Italian marble bathroom with a soak tub and a separate rain shower, according to Condé Nast Traveler.
facts.excerpt: Each room includes a black-and-white Italian marble bathroom with a soak tub and a separate rain shower.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler found a Nespresso machine in the room.
facts.excerpt: the Nespresso machine in the room

facts.text: The Bostonian Seafood & Grill and Main St. Deli are also in the building.
facts.excerpt: Elsewhere in the building, The Bostonian Seafood & Grill serves up surf ‘n’ turf, while Main St. Deli specializes in all things New York-style deli

facts.text: The hotel has two recognised Les Clefs d'Or concierges, according to Condé Nast Traveler.
facts.excerpt: The Langham actually staffs two recognized Les Clefs d'Or members
